items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington had Al Killian, who was a fantastic high note player

ctx.x: No, Oscar Bradley (PHONETIC). Oscar Moore was the guitar player. But the fantastic thing about the whole parade was the high note trumpet player. Jimmie Lunceford had Paul Webster, who was a fantastic high note player, and Duke Ellington had Al Killian, who was a fantastic high note player, and in my band, I had my brother, who was a fantastic high note player. They were just screaming all
down Broadway and it was resounding all between all the walls from the buildings. It was quite a thing.
